ns2:course.label: Readings in Am Ind Studies
ns2:course.description: Individual guidance in intensive readings in the theories and practices of the field of American Indian Studies. May be repeated in the same or subsequent terms to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours or 8 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing or one course in AIS and consent of instructor.
